_notes: Ordering 0. refuse = constant row; route_<m> = filtered probes answered by model m's logged scores (base = never-trained Qwen2.5-3B, no retraining needed); noise = pi-independent N(0,10^2) scores. Aggregators: default z-mean of 16 probes; namefree = z-mean of the 6 probes without the full name; kind_avg = per-canary average of 4 kind-specific plug-in e-values; kind_mix = average of 4 kind-specific plug-in e-processes. All four are valid (Lemma 1 per kind; averages of e-values / test martingales).
